selection.requested_focus: Understand the mechanism and decide what to learn.

insight.title: Controlled execution needs more than a capable component
insight.one_liner: The useful unit is the task plus its execution controls, not the executor alone.
insight.why_this_matters: A successful isolated action can still be unreliable as a system behavior.

whole_source_map.problem: A capable component is not sufficient without a reliable execution system.
whole_source_map.thesis: Separate the task model from the executor.

derived_model.problem: Executor capability is mistaken for system reliability.
derived_model.mechanism: Define a task contract and put authority and verification around execution.
derived_model.result: Different executors can perform the same controlled work.

concepts.name: Task contract
concepts.why_needed: It defines work independently from the executor.

examples.question: Can the same task be safely performed by different executors?

limitations: Concurrency and ownership still require explicit rules.

use_now: Separate task semantics from executor implementation.
